hero.title: One link for requests, scheduling, and live meetings.
hero.description: PonsLink helps you collect meeting requests, approve them with context, and meet in one room with video, audio, chat, file sharing, captions, notes, and more.
hero.imageAlt: PonsLink live room preview with video participants and collaboration cues

flow.heading: Requests, approval, lobby, room, and follow-up stay connected.

collect.title: Collect requests
collect.desc: Visitors send their reason, preferred time, language, and context through your public PonsLink.

approve.title: Approve with context
approve.desc: Review who wants to meet and decide whether to accept, reschedule, decline, or follow up.

meet.title: Meet in one room
meet.desc: Approved people move through the lobby into video, audio, chat, files, captions, and notes.

features.heading: Inside every session, the room keeps the context alive.
features.imageAlt: {{title}} feature artwork for PonsLink room page

voice.title: Voice mode
voice.desc: Jump into lighter rooms when voice is enough. Mute fast, keep the pressure low, and stay present without forcing camera time.

video.title: Video rooms
video.desc: Switch on camera, keep the grid alive, and move from a request link to a real conversation without changing products.

whiteboard.title: Collaborative whiteboard
whiteboard.desc: Sketch, annotate, zoom, and follow each other on the same canvas with pen, shapes, text, and shared focus tools.

chat.title: Live chat
chat.desc: Chat stays inside the room with replies, reactions, message flow, and file handoff support when talking alone is too slow.

ponscast.title: PonsCast
ponscast.desc: Share videos, PDFs, images, and playlists as a live room surface instead of asking everyone to hunt for separate links.

cowatch.title: YouTube CoWatch
cowatch.desc: Open synchronized shared viewing with a dedicated CoWatch control so the room can talk around the same moment in real time.

fileTransfer.title: File transfer
fileTransfer.desc: Move files directly between participants with transfer progress, pause-resume controls, and room-native delivery instead of email ping-pong.

trust.heading: Built for people whose time needs context.
